objective: Expand native pixel-shift aggregation to the Nikon models confirmed below; no other NX Studio features.
evidence_boundaries: An official shooting feature does not establish native merger compatibility.
Ordinary NEF layout and LibRaw decode evidence do not validate a pixel-shift sequence.
Authored fixtures do not establish authentic sensor movement or NX Studio sample parity.
Every model remains experimental until authentic capture/reference and downstream application acceptance.

color_matrix_followup.observation: The original Z5II source decodes but returns an all-zero 3x3 XYZ-to-camera matrix. The LibRaw table contains Zf and Z6III entries but no Z5II entry. Zf and Z6III originals return nonsingular matrices.
color_matrix_followup.runtime_contract: Only the observed all-zero Z5II matrix can be absent. Preserve source color tags and return metadata null plus an explicit merge-report limitation. Nonfinite or nonzero singular matrices still fail; other models retain the matrix requirement. No rendering matrix is invented.
color_matrix_followup.revision_note: Probe adds the matrix field on top of this base; exact probe bytes are pinned by SHA-256.

authentic_ae_reference.capture: NIKON Z 8 firmware C 3.01, 48 lossless 14-bit NEFs SGL_6243..SGL_6290: pixel shift with AE bracketing, three 16-frame sequences at 1/60 s 0 EV, 1/125 s -1 EV and 1/30 s +1 EV; f/2, ISO 1600.
authentic_ae_reference.observed_metadata: Each exposure is its own burst identity (MakerNote 0x56 bytes 4-7) with shot numbers and 0x5e frame ordinals 1-16; absolute shutter counts are consecutive; EXIF ExposureBiasValue carries the bracket offset. BracketSet=AE/Flash, BracketProgram=Disabled and BracketIncrement=1 EV are constant, so no parsed field records the planned exposure count.
authentic_ae_reference.references: NX Studio 1.11 W wrote three NEFX files, one per exposure, named SGL_6243_merged.NEFX, SGL_6259_merged.NEFX and SGL_6275_merged.NEFX, with chromatic aberration correction enabled.
authentic_ae_reference.grouping_conclusion: AE bracketing needs no special handling: grouping by burst identity and ordering by shot number, as Polaris.dll does, yields the same three sequences.
authentic_ae_reference.radial_order: Before 04ac65c, 571, 331 and 952 red/blue samples differed by one at cubic sums within 7.3e-12 of an integer; PixelShiftCombine.dll multiplies the weights before the sample (RVA 0x34b4a3/0x34b4b6). Diagnosis record: /workspaces/LumaForge/nxc-data/acceptance/20261030-z8-ae-reference/evidence.json.
authentic_ae_reference.zero_configuration: At 173d395, cnefx merge <folder> --chromatic-aberration-correction writes the three same-named files beside the captures. All 545,292,288 decoded samples per output match NX Studio; normalized TIFF metadata differs only in Software and DateTime. Rerunning in the original folder refuses before decoding because the NX Studio outputs exist.
authentic_ae_reference.regression: Release and ASan/UBSan CTest, 128 core, 32 format, 36 CLI and the multi-sequence runner pass.
acceptance_gaps: The earlier SGL_6128 32-to-1 reference is no longer available and was not rerun after the radial order fix

coverage_limits: This is the four-model set confirmed from official manuals, not a promise to cover future firmware or every Nikon model.

Z9, Z6II, Z5, Zfc, Z50II and ZR manual indexes did not expose a pixel-shift shooting entry in this bounded check; they are not allowlisted. Z7II manual URL returned 404, so no negative support claim is inferred.
HE/HE*, HLG, non-FX image areas and unobserved metadata versions remain unsupported or unvalidated as documented in project-scope.json.
